acceptance: A promoted or package manifest has a sequence number and not_after inside the signed body; a verifier given the last accepted sequence refuses replay and rollback.

positive.fixture: a newer sequence verifies and advances the stored high-water mark; the accepted manifest verifies again
positive.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry --test manifest; cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-versioning --test promotion

negative.fixture: replayed older manifest, expired manifest, same sequence with different content, edited sequence or window, trust set inside the package
negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry --test cli; cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-versioning --test promotion

regression.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-ir --test semantics --test fixtures

security_and_source_permissions: Freshness is inside the signed digest; the trust set is always an input from outside the verified artifact.
known_limitations: not_after bounds accepting a promotion, not running a stored version
only a development signing key exists
